chunks: And from him, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad, from Hariz, from Zurarah, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:
"Supplication after the obligatory prayer is superior to voluntary prayer."
ai.seo_question: Is supplication after obligatory prayer better than voluntary prayer?
ai.summary: In Shia jurisprudence, this hadith from Al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib* underscores the high status of post-obligatory supplication, often interpreted as referring to the specific *Qunut* or general *Dua* recited after Fajr or other prayers, prioritizing direct divine communion over additional ritual units. Scholars note this elevates the spiritual efficacy of mindful supplication, suggesting that a sincere, brief dua may carry more weight than lengthy but less focused voluntary prayers. This reflects the Shia emphasis on the interplay between ritual action (*fi'l*) and devotional presence (*hudhur al-qalb*).
